easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Bogwater Lumaret trigger.
Resolve the Bogwater Lumaret trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.
